requirement: Foundation 2.1 03-screens.md:5: independent native tab navigation and stable scoped restoration with access recheck
implemented: Versioned identity-only navigation checkpoint for selected Shop/Dinners/Records tab and independent explicit destination paths.
Restores private shopping list by installation actor, ledger workspace and selected shop; saved comparison by installation actor, comparison workspace and record ID.
Household inbox and shared-view management locator waits for explicit fresh verified enrollment matching subject, household, member and shop; present permissions are checked before rendering.
Household revocation/sign-out/scope change invalidates stored destination synchronously; contributor entry clears adult routes. Background lock retains only a locator pending fresh access.
Record deletion, retired ledger workspace, changed local actor or selected shop prevents restoration. Incoming device link clears prior navigation even before local stores open.
No form drafts, consent, grants, roles, capabilities, paid state, private financial projections or SwiftUI navigation internals are serialized.
regression_fix: AppModel separately publishes hasLoadedRecords after successful source listing, preventing a ready-but-empty startup race from deleting a legitimate saved-record route.

device.name: Room in the Cart iOS 17 Small

normal_app_ui_validation.entry: Ordinary shipping SwiftUI root with manually typed fictional groceries; --ui-testing only isolates local persistence.

tests.name: NavigationRestorationUITests/testKillRelaunchRestoresRecordsDetailAndIndependentShoppingList
assertions: Switching tabs retains the live shopping-list stack.
After process termination/relaunch the selected Records tab reopens the same saved comparison without choosing its row.
A second process termination/relaunch restores the selected shopping list and the independent Records comparison stack.

tests.name: NavigationRestorationUITests/testKillRelaunchRestoresSelectedDinnersTabWithoutRestoringUnsavedComparison
assertions: Selected Dinners tab survives process death.
An unsaved comparison editor is discarded on restart.

normal_app_ui_validation.mixed_run_scope: These UI result bundles also contain unrelated contextual reminder tests which failed in those runs; the two navigation cases passed as recorded individually. The initial navigation attempt exposed only an iOS 17 native Back-button selector difference, corrected in the final test source.

verification_scope: Household revocation and identity matrix use actual native HouseholdModel with intercepted .invalid service transport, not production accounts.
No household session, guardian consent, budget authority, paid seat or exported record is restored from the navigation file.
Transient detail routes and sheets resume at the nearest supported explicit source destination; stored UI state contains no unsaved edits.
test_helper_updates: Existing FreeJourney/RoomInTheCart/ContextualNavigation tests recognize intentional restored destinations, and use native tab/back controls when a test explicitly requests a root or source list. Original persistence and record identity assertions remain.

integrated_free_journey_validation.typed_entry: --ui-testing and --reset-test-workspace isolate the local test databases; groceries, dinner, lunch reservation, packs, order, fill, stock, note, finances and feedback are entered through shipping controls.
assertions_preserved: Dinner and protected Lunch survive restart.
Saved sufficient whole packs reach reviewed checkout.
Frozen dated basket stays placement-unconfirmed after restart.
Partial fill and separate confirmed freezer stock protect Lunch.
Complete cook note retains exact instructions and exclusions after restart.
Posted financial evidence remains separate from food outcome.
Local optional feedback can be saved, removed and disabled.
Closing old shop and creating next shop clears store/date and permits the accepted dinner to be chosen for the new shop.
Final restart retains next-shop dinner and Records history retains the original dated repair without inferring meal outcome.
integrated_free_journey_validation.observed_test_only_fix: The optional feedback switch is now below the visible fold in Settings. The test reveals it before its original off-by-default assertion. No domain assertions or production code were changed.
integrated_free_journey_validation.device_released: iPhone 17e is Shutdown; no test process remains.
